title: Recording-panel scoring-move buttons reach 44px with two-column opponent errors
context: The opponent-error column stacked six rows that measured 16 to 36px tall on most iPhones; only Pro Max and Plus models reached 44px, so scoring moves fell below the touch target and short screens risked scrolling mid-rally.
decision: Opponent-error reasons render in two columns of three rows, keeping the label text and the trailing +/- icon. Below 360px viewport width the label font scales down from 24px so labels neither overflow nor wrap. `MoveButton` adds `leading-7` so its natural height is 44px, and rows use `minmax(44px, 1fr)` so they grow on taller screens. Phone landscape and desktop recording layout are handled separately.

alternatives.reason: Scrolling during a live rally costs more time than a denser grid.

alternatives.option: Compress rows or shorten labels to fit
alternatives.reason: Rows would stay under 44px on most iPhones, or the labels would lose meaning.

alternatives.option: Shrink the court to make room
alternatives.reason: The court is the main context for the scorer and shrinking it reduces its legibility.

consequences: The landing record demo renders the real GamePanel and also changes to two columns.
A measurement fixture over iPhone viewports guards the geometry.
revisitTriggers: A supported device cannot fit the two-column layout without scrolling or label overflow.
